target_customer: Hobbyists, makers and non-experts who want to design and build hardware projects
problem: Building hardware used to take weeks of learning CAD, sourcing compatible parts and writing firmware. Confetti turns this into one conversation with AI agents.
business_model: consumer subscription or per-order revenue from ordered 3D printed parts and components (not stated in sources)
product_category: AI hardware design and ordering workbench

founders.name: Tianyi Evans Gu
education: University of Pennsylvania, CS and Math, dropped out
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: won 6 hackathons, published at ICML and AMIA

founders.name: Lucas Yuan
education: University of Pennsylvania, CS, dropped out

competitors.name: Zoo (Zookeeper)
competitors.what: Conversational CAD design agent and text-to-CAD APIs

competitors.name: AdamCAD
competitors.what: Text to parametric 3D model web tool with open source CADAM repo
competitors.traction_then: One review says over 1 million models generated
competitors.funding_then: 4.1M USD seed in October 2025 per a single review site, unverified

competitors.name: Blueprint
competitors.what: a16z speedrun backed vibe coding for hardware

technical_complexity.rationale: Generating valid CAD, compatible parts lists and firmware from prompts is hard to make reliable, though built on frontier models.

defensibility.rationale: Community remix library could compound, but text-to-CAD tools and hardware vibe coding startups were already shipping.

market_need_then: Text-to-CAD tools and AI hardware startups multiplied in 2025 and 2026, showing demand from makers, though a June 2026 analysis said current tools do not yet behave like manufacturing engineers.

identity.voice_and_tone: Brief and inviting, for example What will you make today?

branding.community_and_virality: Community remix feature, no external evidence of virality found.

brand_strength.rationale: Friendly real word but shared by many unrelated companies named Confetti, which makes search confusing.

outcome_analysis: Confetti is an active Fall 2026 company, days into its launch, with no exit or shutdown found for confetti.build. The shared name with other Confetti companies muddied searches. Prior text-to-CAD entrants are the main competition, so the outcome is too early to judge.
notes: Funding search found nothing for confetti.build; a Confetti Series A and a Stadium acquisition in the results concern a different company, withconfetti.com. Competitors dated 2025 to 2026 near the batch.
